blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-drone collaborative detection aims to enhance target recognition by leveraging complementary observations from overlapping aerial viewpoints. Existing approaches typically follow a two-stage pipeline that first establishes cross-view correspondences and then performs fusion-based recognition. However, this decomposition suffers from inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant pairwise modeling, and irreversible error propagation, where incorrect associations inevitably undermine subsequent recognition performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Coupled Association-Recognition Network (CARNet), a unified framework that jointly optimizes cross-view target association and recognition fusion through a shared target-pair representation. To improve association reliability in densely populated scenes with visually similar targets, CARNet explicitly incorporates spatial cues into pairwise relation modeling. Moreover, we introduce two complementary causal-inspired intervention strategies: the first enhances cross-view association by emphasizing appearance-confusing pairs, while the second bolsters the robustness of fusion-based recognition by learning stable multi-view representations under incomplete visual evidence. In addition, we present MDMT-CD, a fine-grained extension of the MDMT dataset that enriches the original vehicle annotations with detailed category labels, providing the first benchmark specifically designed for multi-drone collaborative vehicle detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARNet consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The MDMT-CD dataset and source code will be available at https://github.com/bigdreaming11/CARNet.
blocks.zh: 多德龙协同探测旨在通过利用从相重叠的空中角度获得的补充观测来增强目标识别. 现行做法通常遵循两个阶段的管道,首先建立交叉视图通信,然后进行以聚变为基础的确认。 然而,这种分解存在不一致的优化目标、冗余的双向模型以及不可逆的错误传播,其中不正确的关联不可避免地会损害随后的识别性能。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立联合协会-识别网络(CARNet),这是一个统一框架,通过共享的目标-pair代表,共同优化跨视图目标关联和识别组合。 为了提高具有类似视觉目标的人群密集场景的关联可靠性,CARNet明确将空间提示纳入对等关系模型。 此外,我们引入了两个互补的因果激励干预策略:第一种通过强调相貌相通对来增强交叉相通,而第二种则通过在不完全的视觉证据下学习稳定的多相相通表达,来增强基于聚变的识别力. 此外,我们提出MDMT-CD,这是MDMT数据集的精细扩展,它用详细的类别标签来丰富了原来的车辆说明,提供了专门为多德龙协同车辆检测而设计的第一个基准. 广泛的实验表明,CARNet的业绩一贯高于现有最新方法。 MDMT-CD数据集和源代码将在https://github.com/bigdreaming11/CARNet上提供。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Single-drone object detection is prone to classification errors and struggles to handle challenging scenarios such as occlusion [ 21 ] . In contrast, multi-drone systems enable collaborative observation of the same target from different aerial viewpoints, providing complementary structural and appearance information [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 单德龙对象检测容易发生分类错误并难以处理被隔离等具有挑战性的情况[21]. 相形之下,多德龙系统能够从不同的空中角度协同观测同一目标,提供互补的结构和外观信息[20].

blocks.en: A natural implementation is a two-stage pipeline: an association network first establishes correspondences, and a subsequent fusion classifier recognizes each matched target [ 28 ] . However, the two stages are optimized with heterogeneous objectives, leading to inconsistencies in representation learning and redundant pairwise modeling across modules. Moreover, the cascade design introduces a structural bottleneck where association errors are irrevocably propagated to the recognition stage [ 24 ] . Once the first stage incorrectly links two different vehicles, subsequent feature fusion inevitably aggregates conflicting evidence, making the final prediction unrecoverable. This design is also computationally redundant and inefficient due to duplicated pairwise modeling across stages. This motivates a unified formulation in which target association and fusion recognition are learned through the same target-pair representation.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的执行是两阶段的管道:一个协会网络首先建立通信,随后的聚变分类器确认每个匹配的目标[28]. 然而,两个阶段的优化目标各不相同,导致在代表性学习和跨模块的冗余对等模型制作方面的不一致。 此外,级联设计引入了一个结构瓶颈,即联想错误无可挽回地被传播到识别阶段[24]. 一旦第一阶段错误地连接了两种不同的载体,随后的特性聚变必然会汇集出相冲突的证据,使得最终的预测无法被恢复. 这种设计在计算上也是多余和低效的,因为跨阶段的对接模型重复. 这促使一种统一的表述方式,即通过同样的目标派代表来了解目标联系和核聚变识别。

blocks.en: We address this bottleneck with a position-aware all-pairs relation. For every target in one drone view and every target in the other, we construct a fused relation by combining their cross-view visual descriptors. LGSGMM [ 50 ] demonstrat , positional information provides valuable geometric cues that improve feature discriminability and correspondence estimation under appearance ambiguity. Motivated by this observation, we encode each target center using a learnable Fourier embedding and inject the resulting positional representation into the fused relation, allowing it to jointly model visual appearance and spatial consistency across views. Each fused target-pair relation is mapped to a C + 1 C+1 distribution containing C C fine-grained vehicle categories and one no-match state. Consequently, the relation tensor serves as a unified target-pair representation that jointly performs cross-view target association and fusing recognition within a single prediction stage, eliminating the conventional separation between association and fusion-based recognition. This unified formulation enables CARNet to replace the conventional association network and fusion recognition with a single prediction stage.
blocks.zh: 我们在解决这个瓶颈时,采用了一种立场意识全方位的关系。 对于一个无人机视野中的每一个目标,以及另一个视野中的每一个目标,我们通过结合其交叉视图的视觉描述来构建一个被保险的关系. LGSGMM [50] demonttrat, 位置信息提供了宝贵的几何提示, 基于这一观察,我们用可学习的傅里叶嵌入法将每个目标中心编码,并将由此而来的位置代表注入被熔接的关系,使其能联合地模拟视觉外观和各种观点的空间一致性. 每个已引信的目标-pair关系被映射为C+1 C+1分布,包含C细纹车辆类别和一无相配状态. 因此, " 关系网 " 是一种统一的目标-pair代表,在一个单一的预测阶段内共同进行交叉视图目标关联和引信识别,消除了传统意义上的关联和以聚变为基础的识别分离。 这种统一配制使CARNet能够以单一的预测阶段来取代传统的联合网络和聚变识别.

blocks.en: However, even with the unified target-pair modeling scheme, association learning may still struggle to capture discriminative correspondence evidence from challenging target pairs. Existing supervision paradigms typically optimize pairwise relations based on matching labels, while overlooking the varying discriminative difficulty among different target pairs. Since easy negative pairs provide straightforward optimization signals, the model tends to prioritize learning easily separable appearance patterns, whereas the fine-grained identity cues and critical correspondence evidence embedded in highly similar target pairs remain insufficiently explored, resulting in incorrect associations in complex scenarios.
blocks.zh: 然而,即使采用统一的目标-pair建模计划,社团学习仍然可能难以从挑战对象对中获取歧视性的函证. 现有的监督范式一般根据相匹配的标签来优化对等关系,而忽略了不同目标对等之间不同的区别性困难. 由于容易的负对提供了直截了当的优化信号,该模型倾向于优先学习容易分离的外观模式,而嵌入高度相近的目标对的精细的标识提示和批判性函证仍然未得到充分探索,导致复杂情景中的关联不正确.

blocks.en: Motivated by Pearl’s causal hierarchy [ 7 ] , CARNet introduces two complementary intervention strategies to guide the model toward learning stable cross-view correspondence evidence. The first enhances cross-view correspondence by assigning greater learning emphasis to appearance-confusing non-matching target pairs, encouraging the model to devote more optimization capacity to challenging correspondence decisions. The second intervention perturbs the visual evidence within target pairs and enforces consistency between the original and intervened relation representations, encouraging the model to learn stable correspondence representations that remain robust under visual variations and incomplete observations.
blocks.zh: 受珍珠因果等级激励 [7], CARNet引入了两个互补的干预策略来指导模型学习稳定的交叉视图函证. 第一种可以加强交叉视图通信,更强调外观相通的不匹配目标对,鼓励模型将更多的优化能力用于挑战通信决定. 第二次干预扰乱了目标对内视觉证据,并强化了原始和被干预关系表述的一致性,鼓励模型学习在视觉差异和不完整观察下仍然坚固的稳定函证.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: 1. We establish MDMT-CD, a fine-grained extension of the MDMT dataset by enriching the original single-category vehicle annotations with fine-grained category labels. 2. We propose CARNet, a unified pairwise relation framework that integrates cross-view correspondence and fusion recognition in a single prediction stage. 3. We propose two causal-inspired intervention strategies that improve cross-view correspondence in densely distributed scenes with appearance-similar targets while enhancing the robustness of multi-view fusion recognition. 4. CARNet achieves state-of-the-art collaborative detection and cross-view association performance on the MDMT-CD datasets, the best association performance on the infrared and cross-modal subsets of M3Track, and further demonstrates excellent generalization on the cross-camera multi-object tracking benchmarks Wildtrack and MvMHAT.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 1. 我们建立了MDMT-CD,这是MDMT数据集的精细扩展,通过用精细的分类标签来丰富原单类车辆说明. 2. 我们提议建立CARNet,这是一个统一的对等关系框架,将交叉视图对应和聚变识别纳入一个单一的预测阶段。 3. 我们提出两个因果激励的干预战略,这些战略在分布密集的场景中改进有外观相似目标的交叉视图通信,同时增强多视图聚变识别的强性. 4. CARNet在MDMT-CD数据集上实现了最先进的协作检测和交叉视图关联性能,在M3Track的红外和跨模式子集上实现了最佳关联性能,并进一步展示了跨相机多对象跟踪基准Wirdtrack和MvMHAT的出色概括.

blocks.en: We establish MDMT-CD, a fine-grained extension of the MDMT dataset by enriching the original single-category vehicle annotations with fine-grained category labels.
blocks.zh: 我们建立了MDMT-CD,这是MDMT数据集的精细扩展,通过用精细的分类标签来丰富原单类车辆说明.

blocks.en: We propose CARNet, a unified pairwise relation framework that integrates cross-view correspondence and fusion recognition in a single prediction stage.
blocks.zh: 我们提出CARNet,一个统一的对等关系框架,在单一的预测阶段将交叉视图的对应和聚变识别结合起来.

blocks.en: We propose two causal-inspired intervention strategies that improve cross-view correspondence in densely distributed scenes with appearance-similar targets while enhancing the robustness of multi-view fusion recognition.
blocks.zh: 我们提出两个因果启发的干预战略,在分布分布密集的场景中改进有外观相似目标的交叉视图通信,同时增强多视图聚变识别的强性.

blocks.en: CARNet achieves state-of-the-art collaborative detection and cross-view association performance on the MDMT-CD datasets, the best association performance on the infrared and cross-modal subsets of M3Track, and further demonstrates excellent generalization on the cross-camera multi-object tracking benchmarks Wildtrack and MvMHAT.
blocks.zh: CARNet在MDMT-CD数据集上实现了最先进的合作检测和交叉视图关联性能,在M3Track的红外和跨模式子集上实现了最佳关联性能,并进一步展示了跨相机多对象跟踪基准Wirdtrack和MvMHAT上的出色概括.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multi-Drone Collaborative Perception
blocks.zh: 2.1 多龙协作概念

blocks.en: Multi-drone collaborative perception exploits complementary observations from multiple UAVs to alleviate limited fields of view, occlusion, small object scales, and unstable imaging conditions. Early studies mainly focused on collaborative tracking. Zhu et al. [ 54 ] proposed an agent-sharing network that exchanges reliable target templates and performs view-aware fusion for multi-drone single-object tracking. Liu et al. [ 23 ] introduced the MDMT benchmark and MIA-Net, which combine within-view tracking with cross-drone identity authentication to recover targets occluded in individual views. Wu et al. [ 40 ] further enhanced multi-drone multi-object tracking through temporal–spatial feature interaction. Beyond UAV-specific settings, Nguyen et al. [ 27 ] formulated multi-camera multi-object tracking as a single-stage global association problem, jointly reasoning about detections and cross-camera correspondences in overlapping views. Zheng et al. [ 51 ] further improved multi-object association under occlusion through motion-guided cross-temporal aggregation and hierarchical matching.
blocks.zh: 多德龙合作感知利用多起无人机的互补观测来缓解有限的视野,被隐蔽,小物体尺度,和不稳定的成像条件. 早期的研究主要侧重于协作跟踪. 朱等编. [54] 提出一个代理共享网络,用于交换可靠的目标模板并进行多德龙单对象跟踪的视觉聚合. 刘等. [23] 引入了MDMT基准和MIA-Net,它们结合了取景内跟踪和跨德龙身份认证,以取回个人观点所占据的目标. 吴等. [40] 通过时间-空间特征相互作用,进一步强化多德龙多对象跟踪. 在UAV特定设置之外,Nguyen等. [27] 制定了多相机多对象跟踪作为单相相机全球关联问题,在重叠观点中联合推理检测和交叉相机对应. 郑等. [51] 通过运动导取的跨时相聚合和分级相配,在隔离下进一步改善了多对象相接.

blocks.en: Recent research has increasingly investigated feature-level collaborative detection. DiscoNet [ 16 ] learns a collaboration graph under teacher–student distillation, whereas Where2comm [ 11 ] communicates only spatial regions with high perceptual confidence. V2X-ViT [ 44 ] , CoBEVT [ 43 ] and CoBEVFlow [ 37 ] further address heterogeneous observations, sparse cross-agent fusion, communication redundancy, and temporal asynchrony. Although several of these methods were initially developed for vehicle-based agents, their feature alignment and communication mechanisms are also applicable to UAV collaboration.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究越来越多地调查地物层面的合作探测。 DiscoNet [16] 在师生蒸馏法下学习协作图,而Where2comm [11] 仅沟通具有高知觉信心的空间区域. V2X-ViT [44],CoBEVT [43]和CoBEVFlow [37] 进一步解决了各种观测,分散的交叉物剂聚变,通信冗余,以及时间同步. 虽然其中几种方法最初是为以车辆为主的物剂而开发的,但其特征相配合和通信机制也适用于无人驾驶航空器合作.

blocks.en: For UAV-specific three-dimensional perception, UAV3D [ 45 ] provides benchmarks for collaborative 3D detection and tracking, while UCDNet [ 36 ] maps multi-UAV image features into a common 3D space using depth priors and geometric consistency. MCOP [ 17 ] extends collaboration from bounding-box detection to dense occupancy prediction with altitude-aware compression. V2U4Real [ 13 ] studies real-world vehicle-to-UAV cooperative detection, and AirCopBench [ 49 ] evaluates multi-drone embodied perception and reasoning. Nevertheless, most existing methods output trajectories, boxes, or occupancy states, while target-level correspondence and fine-grained collaborative recognition remain insufficiently coupled.
blocks.zh: 对于UAV特定的三维感知,UAV3D[45]为协作3D检测和跟踪提供了基准,而UCDNet[36]将多维AV图像特征用深度前身和几何一致性映射到一个共同的3D空间. MCOP [17] 将协作范围从边框-box检测扩展到高地-意识压缩的密集占用预测. V2U4 Real [13]研究现实世界的车辆对UAV合作检测,而AirCop Bench [49] 则评价了多德罗内含的认知和推理. 尽管如此,大多数现行方法都输出出轨迹、箱型或占用状态,而目标层面的函证和精细的协作识别仍然没有充分结合。

blocks.en: 2.2 Cross-View Target Association
blocks.zh: 2.2 跨视线目标协会

blocks.en: Cross-view target association aims to determine whether targets observed by different UAVs correspond to the same physical object. Compared with conventional multi-object tracking, the task is considerably more challenging due to drastic viewpoint changes, severe rotations, scale variations, target occlusions, and dense distributions of visually similar objects.
blocks.zh: 交叉视野目标关联旨在确定不同无人驾驶航空器所观察到的目标是否与同一种物理物体相对应. 与常规多对象跟踪相比,由于视觉相近对象的剧烈视角变化、剧烈旋转、规模变化、目标被隔离和密集分布,这项任务具有更大的挑战性。

blocks.en: Existing UAV-oriented methods mainly exploit geometric consistency to establish cross-view correspondences. Li et al. [ 15 ] represented each target using triangular topological sequences and performed globally consistent association through two-stage assignment. Liu et al. [ 22 ] introduced the MDMT benchmark and proposed MIA-Net, which first establishes image-level correspondences using SIFT features and then associates tracked targets across UAVs through geometric verification. Qiao et al. [ 29 ] proposed STCA, which estimates inter-view transformations, identifies common visible regions, and performs bidirectional cross-drone association. Tan et al. [ 35 ] further formulated target association as a graph matching problem and exploited reliable spatial relationships to improve robustness under missed and false detections.
blocks.zh: 现有的以无人机为导向的方法主要利用几何一致性来建立交叉取景函. 李等编. [15] 代表每个目标使用三角地貌序列,并通过两阶段任务实现全球一致的联系。 刘等. [22]引入了MDMT基准并提出了MIA-Net,该基准首先使用SIFT特性建立图像级通信,再由相关人员通过几何验证在无人驾驶飞行器上跟踪目标. Q等. [29] 提议的STCA,它估计了相视变换,确定了共同的可见区域,并进行双向的相接. 谭等. [35] 进一步制定了目标关联,作为图表匹配问题,并利用了可靠的空间关系,以提高在漏测和假检测下的稳健性.

blocks.en: Besides these dedicated UAV-oriented methods, appearance-based ReID models and deep image matching networks are also widely adopted as association baselines. However, appearance-based methods such as Re-ID [ 10 ] , OSNet [ 52 ] , ReIDMamba [ 6 ] , CrossMOT [ 9 ] , CT [ 38 ] , AGW [ 46 ] , mainly rely on visual similarity and therefore struggle to distinguish densely distributed targets with highly similar appearances. Deep image matching methods, such as SuperGlue [ 32 ] , LoFTR [ 34 ] and Roma [ 5 ] , often experience noticeable performance degradation under the large rotation differences commonly encountered between UAV views. Moreover, MIA-Net depends on handcrafted SIFT features for image registration, resulting in relatively low computational efficiency. Furthermore, most existing methods perform target association as an independent preprocessing stage, making it difficult to jointly optimize cross-view association and downstream collaborative recognition.
blocks.zh: 除了这些专门的面向无人驾驶航空器的方法外,基于外观的ReID模型和深图像匹配网络也被广泛采用作为关联基线. 然而,以外观为基础的方法,如Re-ID [10],OSNet [52],ReIDMamba [6],CrossMOT [9],CT [38],AGW [46],主要依靠视觉相似性,因此难以区分外观高度相似的分布密集的目标. 深图像匹配方法,如SuperGlue [32],LoFTR [34]和Roma [5],在无人驾驶飞行器观点之间通常遇到的巨大旋转差异下,经常出现明显的性能退化. 此外,MIA-Net依赖手工制作的SIFT特性进行图像注册,导致计算效率相对较低. 此外,大多数现有方法都把目标关联作为独立的预处理阶段,使得难以共同优化交叉视图关联和下游合作识别.

blocks.en: 3 Fine-Grained MDMT Annotation
blocks.zh: 3 精细MDMT 注释

blocks.en:
The original MDMT dataset assigns all vehicle targets to a single category, car, which limits its capability for fine-grained semantic analysis. In this work, we extend MDMT by retaining the original cross-view identity annotations and further refining the object labels into seven fine-grained categories: car, bus, van, truck, tricycle, bicycle, and pedestrian. This extension enables more comprehensive evaluation of multi-view target perception and association under diverse object types.
In addition, we manually verify the entire dataset and correct annotation errors from the original release to improve annotation reliability. Each annotation record consists of the object category, target identity (ID), and bounding box information.
blocks.zh:
最初的MDMT数据集将所有车辆目标指定为单一类别,即汽车,这限制了其精细纹理语义分析的能力. 在这部作品中,我们通过保留原有的交叉视图身份说明来扩展MDMT,并进一步完善对象标签为7个精细的类别:汽车,公交车,面包车,卡车,三轮车,自行车,和行人. 这一扩展使得能够更全面地评价不同对象类型的多视图目标感知和关联。
此外,我们还手动验证了整个数据集,并纠正了出自原版的注释错误,以提高注释可靠性. 每个注释记录由对象类别,目标身份(ID)和边框信息组成.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overall pipeline of the proposed CARNet. Given two drone views, target features are extracted and used to construct position-aware all-pairs relations. Each target-pair relation is mapped to a unified C + 1 C+1 distribution for joint cross-view association and collaborative recognition, while two causal-inspired intervention are applied during training.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议CARNet的整个管道。 鉴于无人机的两种观点,目标特征被提取出来并用于构建位置感知到的全平面关系. 每个目标-pair关系均被绘制为统一的C+1 C+1分布,用于联合交叉视图协会和协作识别,同时在培训期间采用两个因果激励的干预措施.

blocks.en:
Given a pair of UAV images ( I A , I B ) (I^{A},I^{B}) , the onboard object detector first extracts M M target instances from I A I^{A} and N N target instances from I B I^{B} .
Conventional collaborative detection methods generally decompose the task into two successive stages. First, cross-view object association is performed to establish correspondences between targets observed from different UAVs. Then, multi-view feature fusion is conducted for the matched target pairs to obtain the final fused recognition results.
blocks.zh:
鉴于一对无人驾驶飞行器图像(I A, I B)(I^{A}, I^{B}),机上物体探测器首先从I A I^{A}提取出M M目标实例,从I B I^{B}提取出N N目标实例.
常规协作检测方法一般会将任务分解为相继的两个阶段. 首先,进行交叉视物体协会,以建立从不同无人驾驶航空器观测到的目标之间的通信。 然后,为匹配的目标对进行多视图特性聚变,以获得最终的引信识别结果.

blocks.en: In contrast, we formulate object association and multi-view feature fusion as a unified end-to-end framework, enabling one-stage collaborative object detection for multi-drone systems. The overall pipeline of the proposed method is illustrated in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 相形之下,我们将对象关联和多视图特性聚变形成统一的端到端框架,使得多德龙系统能够进行一相协作对象检测. 图1说明了拟议方法的总体编审情况。

blocks.en: 4.1 Position-Aware Pairwise Relation Modeling
blocks.zh: 4.1 定位软件对等关系模型

blocks.en:

blocks.en: Dense scenes contain many visually similar vehicles. This may create an appearance shortcut: visually similar targets are treated as matched targets. Although the pairwise loss supervises all valid target pairs, the optimization contribution of difficult relations remains limited because the relation distribution is highly imbalanced and dominated by easy no-match pairs. To suppress this shortcut, we introduce a hard non-match intervention. This intervention does not generate new training pairs. Instead, it selects appearance-confusing no-match pairs from existing all-pairs relations and imposes additional no-match supervision on them.

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets and Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集和实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed method on four benchmarks. MDMT-CD is used for multi-drone collaborative detection and target association, while M3Track are used for cross-view target association. To further examine generalization, we also conduct experiments on two cross-camera multi-person tracking benchmarks, Wildtrack and MvMHAT.
blocks.zh: 我们按四个基准评估拟议方法。 MDMT-CD用于多德龙合作检测和目标关联,而M3Track用于交叉视图目标关联. 为了进一步检查通俗化,我们还对两个跨相机多人跟踪基准,Wildtrack和MvMHAT进行了实验.

blocks.en: MDMT-CD contains small-scale aerial targets, dense appearance-similar objects, severe occlusions, and large viewpoint variations, making cross-view association challenging. M3Track contains low-altitude UAV and ground-camera views, including both visible-spectrum and infrared sequences, and is used to evaluate association under modality and viewpoint changes. The image resolutions of MDMT and M3Track are 1920 × \times 1080 and 640 × \times 512, respectively.
blocks.zh: MDMT-CD包含小型的空中目标,密集的外观类似物体,严重的隐蔽,以及巨大的视差相变,使得交叉视距关联具有挑战性. M3Track包含低海拔的无人驾驶飞行器和地相机视图,包括可见光谱和红外线序列,用于评价模式和视角变化下的关联. MDMT和M3Track的图像分辨率分别为1920 ×\times 1080和640×\times 512.

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison of Collaborative Detection Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 协作检测绩效比较

blocks.en: Since there are currently no mature methods specifically designed for collaborative object detection in multi-drone systems, we construct a strong baseline by combining the state-of-the-art cross-view object association method LGSGMM [ 50 ] with representative multi-view classification models, forming an "target association–fusing recognition" pipeline. Specifically, the compared fusion methods include DS [ 4 ] , MVCNN [ 33 ] , TMC [ 8 ] , SMDC [ 18 ] , ARA [ 19 ] , and UVF [ 25 ] . In addition, we consider two simple yet widely adopted engineering baselines. The first selects the final category according to the detection confidence of a single drone, referred to as DC (Decision by Confidence). The second directly concatenates the features extracted from different views and feeds them into an MLP for classification, referred to as CMLP (Concatenation + MLP). To evaluate the effectiveness of CARNet, we compare it with the aforementioned single-view, decision-level fusion, and feature-level fusion approaches. The quantitative results are reported in Table 1 , while qualitative comparisons are presented in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 由于目前还没有专门为多德龙系统的合作对象检测而设计的成熟方法,我们通过将最先进的交叉视对象关联方法LGSGMM[50]与具有代表性的多视分级模型相结合,形成"目标关联-放入识别"的管道来构建一个强大的基线. 具体而言,比较的聚变方法包括DS [4],MVCNN [33],TMC [8],SMDC [18],ARA [19],和UVF [25]. 此外,我们认为有两个简单而得到广泛采纳的工程基线。 第一种根据单人无人机的探测信心选择最终类别,称为DC(由信任决定). 第二种直接将从不同观点中取出的特点收缩,并用MLP来进行分类,称为CMLP(Concation + MLP). 为了评估CARNet的有效性,我们将它与上述单一观点、决策层面的聚变和特征层面的聚变方法进行比较。 量化结果见表1,质量比较见图2。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , decision-level fusion methods based on single-drone logits or class probabilities, such as DS, TMC, SMDC, and ARA, consistently outperform visual feature fusion methods such as MVCNN and UVF. This is because category outputs directly provide task-relevant discriminative evidence, while evidence modeling, uncertainty estimation, and unreliable-view rejection further alleviate cross-view prediction conflicts, thereby improving multi-drone collaborative recognition accuracy. However, these methods do not fully exploit the visual and positional information of the targets. CARNet further models all M × N M\times N cross-view target pairs through a unified C + 1 C+1 relation distribution. By jointly exploiting visual interactions, spatial cues, and intervention-based training, it improves association among densely distributed similar vehicles and performs association, fusion, and recognition within a single framework. Compared with the single-drone baseline, CARNet improves m ​ A ​ P 50 mAP_{50} by 1.78% ( 25.23 % − 23.45 % ) (25.23\%-23.45\%) . Compared with the strongest existing collaborative detection baseline, TMC, CARNet improves m ​ A ​ P 50 mAP_{50} by 1.56% ( 25.23 % − 23.67 % ) (25.23\%-23.67\%) . Meanwhile, CARNet reduces the latency from 89 ms to 48 ms, demonstrating both higher accuracy and better inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,基于单德龙对数或类概率的决定级聚变方法,如DS,TMC,SMDC,和ARA,一贯表现优于MVCNN和UVF等视觉特征聚变方法. 这是因为类别产出直接提供与任务相关的歧视性证据,而证据模型化,不确定性估计和不可靠视图拒绝则会进一步缓解交叉视图预测冲突,从而提高多德龙合作识别的准确性. 然而,这些方法并没有充分利用目标的视觉和位置信息. CARNet 进一步模拟所有 M × N M\ Times N通过统一的C+1 C+1关系分布的交叉视图目标对. 通过联合利用视觉互动、空间提示和基于干预的培训,它改善了分布密集的类似载体之间的关联,并在单一框架内进行关联、融合和承认。 与单叉线基线相比,CARNet将m A P 50 mAP _{50}改进了1.78%(25.23% - 23.45%) (25.23-23.45%)。 与现有的最强合作检测基线(TMC)相比,CARNet将m A P 50 mAP_{50}改进了1.56%(25.23%−23.67%)(25.23\%-23.67%)。 同时,CARNet将延迟从89 ms降低到48 ms,显示出更高的准确性和更好的推论效率.

blocks.en:
To further evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method in scenarios with densely distributed similar targets, we compare it with representative state-of-the-art cross-view object association methods on the MDMT-CD dataset, including Re-ID , OSNet , ReIDMamba , GTA-Net, TTS [ 14 ] , MIA-Net , SuperGlue , LoFTR , E-LoFTR , JamMa, MambaGlue [ 31 ] , and RoMa . Among them, MIA-Net is based on SIFT, while SuperGlue, LoFTR, E-LoFTR, JamMa, MambaGlue, and RoMa are state-of-the-art deep learning-based image matching methods that estimate homography matrices for cross-view object mapping. The quantitative results are reported in Table 2 . As shown in the table, image matching-based object association methods generally struggle with large rotation variations between views, resulting in the poorest performance on the MDMT-CD dataset. Appearance similarity-based association methods are also prone to incorrect associations due to the presence of numerous visually similar objects in UAV views. In contrast, the proposed CARNet achieves a 3.93% improvement over MIA-Net in terms of MDA (40.81% vs. 36.88%) while maintaining more than 10× higher computational efficiency. Compared with the current state-of-the-art LGSGMM, CARNet achieves comparable association performance with significantly improved efficiency.
Fig. 3 shows the qualitative association results. As can be observed, CARNet can effectively associate densely distributed and visually similar objects, even under large rotation and viewpoint variations between image pairs. Moreover, it maintains robust association performance in nighttime scenarios with sparse object appearances. This improvement benefits from the incorporation of positional information and the proposed full object-pair modeling strategy, which jointly exploit spatial and visual relationships for discriminative association.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步评价拟议方法在分布密集的类似目标情况下的有效性,我们将它与MDMT-CD数据集上具有代表性的一流的交叉视图对象关联方法进行比较,包括Re-ID、OSNet、ReIDMamba、GTA-Net、TTS[14]、MIA-Net、SuperGlue、LoFTR、E-LoFTR、Jamma、MambaGlue[31]和RoMa。 其中,MIA-Net基于SIFT,而SuperGlue,LoFTR,E-LoFTR,JamMa,MambaGlue,和RoMa都是最先进的以深层学习为基础的图像匹配方法,用来估计交叉视图对象映射的同位素矩阵. 量化结果见表2。 如表格所显示,基于图像匹配对象关联方法一般会与视图相去甚远的旋转相去甚远,导致MDMT-CD数据集的性能最差. 由于无人机观点中存在许多视觉相近物体,基于外观的关联方法也容易出现不正确的关联. 相比之下,拟议的CARNet在MDA(40.81%对36.88%)方面比MIA-Net取得了3.93%的改进,同时保持了10x多高的计算效率。 与目前最先进的LGSGMM相比,CARNet实现了可比较的关联性能并大大提高了效率.
图3显示了质量关联结果。 可以看到,CARNet可以有效地将分布稠密和视觉相近的物体连接起来,即使在图像对之间的大旋转和视线变化下也是如此. 此外,它在夜间假想中保持强健的关联性能,且物体外观稀少. 这一改进得益于纳入位置信息和拟议的完全的物体-铺设模型战略,这些战略共同利用空间和视觉关系促进歧视性联系。

To further evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method in scenarios with severe non-rigid target deformation and cross-modal variations, we compare it with representative state-of-the-art cross-view object association methods on the M3Track dataset, including OSNet, CrossMOT , CT , AGW , ReIDMamba, GTA-Net, TTS, MambaGlue, and MIA-Net.

为了进一步评估拟议方法在具有严重非固定目标变形和跨模式变异的情景中的有效性,我们把它与M3Track数据集上具有代表性的最新跨视对象关联方法进行比较,其中包括OSNet、CrossMOT、CT、AGW、ReIDMamba、GTA-Net、TTS、MambaGlue和MIA-Net。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 , Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 shows qualitative association results. Appearance-based association methods, such as AGW and CT, mainly rely on target visual similarity and therefore struggle to distinguish densely distributed targets with similar appearances. LGSGMM implicitly introduces positional cues to guide attention aggregation. However, when targets are heavily occluded or observed across different modalities, inaccurate attention aggregation may introduce misleading context and reduce feature discriminability. As shown in the figure, CARNet can still accurately associate targets under severe non-rigid deformations, dense crowds, and heavy occlusions. This robustness benefits from explicitly incorporating positional information into pairwise relation modeling, which enables more reliable association under challenging scenarios. Moreover, CARNet maintains strong performance in both same-modal and cross-modal association scenarios.
blocks.zh: 图4、图5和图6显示了联系的质量结果。 基于外观的关联方法,如AGW和CT,主要依靠目标视觉相似性,因此在相似外观下努力区分出分布密集的目标. LGSGMM 隐含地引入了位置提示来引导注意力聚合. 然而,当目标被严重占用或观察到不同模式时,不准确的注意力汇总可能会造成误导性背景并减少特征歧视。 如图所示,CARNet仍然可以准确地将目标与严重的非刚性变形,密集的人群和重的被隔离物联系起来. 这种稳健性得益于将位置信息明确纳入对等关系模型,从而能够在具有挑战性的情况下建立更可靠的联系。 此外,CARNet在同式和同式结合两种情况下都保持了良好的性能。

blocks.en: We further evaluate CARNet on natural cross-view tracking datasets, including Wildtrack and MvMHAT. As shown in Table 4 , we compare our method with representative multi-camera tracking and association methods, including KSP-DO [ 2 ] , KSP-DO-track [ 2 ] , GLMB-DO [ 2 ] , DMCT [ 48 ] , DMCT Stack [ 48 ] , ReST [ 3 ] , TSMMT [ 39 ] , Tracktor++ [ 1 ] , CenterTrack [ 53 ] , TraDeS [ 41 ] , TrackFormer [ 26 ] , DeepCC [ 30 ] , and SVT. TSMMT uses temporal information from adjacent video frames, while CARNet only uses the current cross-view image pair without relying on preceding or subsequent frames.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价CARNet的自然交叉视图跟踪数据集,包括Wildtrack和MvMHAT. 如表4所示,我们的方法与具有代表性的多相机跟踪和关联方法进行比较,包括KSP-DO [2],KSP-DO-track [2],GLMB-DO [2],DMCT [48],DMCT Stack [48],ReST [3],TMMT [39],Tracktor++ [1],CenterTrack [53],TradeS [41],TrackFormer [26],DeepCC [30],和SVT. TSMMT使用相邻视频帧的时间信息,而CARNet只使用当前交叉视图的图像对而无需依赖前帧或后帧.

blocks.en: Despite this more restricted input setting, CARNet achieves the best results on both datasets. On Wildtrack, CARNet obtains 86.9% MOTA and 88.5% IDF1. On MvMHAT, it achieves 72.3% MOTA and 52.0% IDF1. These results demonstrate that the proposed position-aware all-pairs relation modeling is effective for natural cross-view object association and can provide strong association performance even without temporal video cues.
blocks.zh: 尽管输入设置较为受限,CARNet在两个数据集上都取得了最佳效果. 在Wildtrack上,CARNet获得86.9%的MOTA和88.5%的IDF1. 在MvMHAT上,它实现了72.3%的MOTA和52.0%的IDF1. 这些结果表明,拟议的位置意识全平关系模型对于自然交叉视图对象关联有效,即使没有时间视频提示也能提供强大的关联性能.

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of position-aware relation modeling and the proposed intervention strategy, we conduct ablation studies on the MDMT dataset. As shown in Table 5 , removing either module causes a significant decrease in MDA, indicating that both components are critical for robust cross-view correspondence. Position-aware relation modeling improves the discriminability of visually similar targets by incorporating spatial cues, while the intervention strategy enhances the learning of discriminative correspondence evidence from appearance-confusing target pairs.
blocks.zh: 为了评估位置意识关系模型和拟议干预战略的有效性,我们对MDMT数据集进行了扩展研究。 如表5所显示的,删除两个模块都会导致MDA的大幅下降,表明这两个组件对强力交叉视图对应至关重要. 定位-认知关系模型化通过纳入空间提示来提高视觉相近目标的可歧视性,而干预策略则能从外观相通的目标对中增强对差异性函证的学习.

blocks.en: To investigate the effect of Visual-Evidence Perturbation Intervention, we conduct an ablation study on MDMT-CD with different dropout rates, as shown in Fig. 7 . As the dropout rate increases, collaborative recognition performance first improves and then declines. This is expected: moderate perturbation prevents the model from over-relying on unstable visual dimensions and encourages stable relation representations under partial evidence loss, improving robustness to viewpoint changes, occlusion, and appearance variations. However, excessive dropout removes too much discriminative evidence, weakening reliable association and recognition.
blocks.zh: 为了调查视觉-证据干扰干预的影响,我们开展了一项关于MDMT-CD的发育研究,辍学率不同,见图7。 随着退学率的上升,合作识别表现首先会改善,而后会下降. 预计这种情况是:温和地扰动可以防止模型过度依赖不稳定的视觉维度,并鼓励在部分证据损失下稳定的关系表示,提高能看清变化、隐蔽和外观变化的稳健性。 然而,过度辍学消除了太多的歧视性证据,削弱了可靠的联系和承认。

blocks.en: 5.6 Paramater and Glops Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.6 参数和光滑分析

blocks.en: We further evaluate the scalability of CARNet by replacing the feature extraction backbone with networks of different capacities. As shown in Table 6 , CARNet can be flexibly adapted to different efficiency requirements. With the same ResNet-50 backbone, CARNet uses only about two-thirds of the parameters of LGSGMM and achieves better MDA performance, demonstrating the parameter efficiency of the proposed pairwise relation framework.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估CARNet的可扩展性,用不同能力的网络取代特征提取主干网。 如表6所示,CARNet可以灵活地适应不同的效率要求。 使用相同的ResNet-50主干线,CARNet只使用LGSGMM的大约三分之二的参数,并实现更好的MDA性能,展示了拟议的对等关系框架的参数效率.

blocks.en: When lightweight deployment is required, smaller backbones can be adopted. ResNet-18 greatly reduces the model size and computation while maintaining an acceptable MDA decrease. MobileNetV3 and ShuffleNetV2 further reduce the computational cost, but the performance drop becomes more evident. These results show that CARNet provides a flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-off for different deployment scenarios.
blocks.zh: 当需要轻量级部署时,可以采用更小的骨干. ResNet-18在保持可接受的MDA减幅的同时,大大降低了模型大小和计算. MobileNetV3和ShuffleNetV2进一步降低了计算成本,但性能下降会更明显. 这些结果表明,CARNet为不同的部署设想提供了灵活的精确效率取舍。

blocks.en: We further evaluate CARNet with different single-drone detectors. As shown in Table 7 , CARNet consistently improves collaborative recognition across all evaluated detectors. Moreover, larger gains are achieved with weaker detectors, demonstrating the robustness and detector-agnostic nature of the proposed framework.
blocks.zh: 我们用不同的单德龙探测器进一步评价CARNet。 如表7所示,CARNet不断改进对所有受评价探测器的协作识别。 此外,利用更弱的探测器取得了更大的成果,这表明拟议框架的稳健性和可预见性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we proposed CARNet and established MDMT-CD, a fine-grained benchmark for collaborative target detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on MDMT-CD, M3Track, Wildtrack, and MvMHAT. These results show that the proposed method is effective for collaborative detection, cross-view target association, and cross-camera multi-object tracking, providing a strong and practical solution for multi-drone perception. However, CARNet relies on the outputs of single-drone detectors. If a target is missed by the detector, the subsequent association and fusion stages cannot recover it. Inaccurate bounding-box localization may also affect the extracted appearance features and positional representations. Future work will therefore explore the joint optimization of single-drone detection, cross-view target association, and multi-view fusion recognition.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了CARNet,并建立了MDMT-CD,这是合作检测目标的一个精细基准。 广泛的实验表明,CARNet在MDMT-CD,M3Track,Wildtrack,和MvMHAT上实现了最先进的性能. 这些结果显示,所拟议的方法对于协作检测,跨视目标关联,并跨相机多对象跟踪都是有效的,为多德龙感知提供了有力而实用的解决方案. 然而,CARNet依赖于单德龙探测器的输出. 如果一个目标被探测器错过了,后续的关联和聚变阶段无法恢复. 不准确的边框-框本地化也可能影响所提取的外观特征和位置表示. 因此,今后的工作将探索联合优化单德龙检测,交叉视标关联,多视聚变识别.
